items.description: The report says unregisterVault() requires totalAssets() and ERC20 balanceOf(vaultAddress) to be zero before removal, but the selected predicate only binds the ERC20 balance and assumes totalAssets() is zero or identical for the core relation.
The report states a dust donation can make balanceOf(vaultAddress) non-zero but does not define a complete independent before-condition for the security intent beyond the zero-balance guard.
